final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence. The response is mainly a narrower interpretation of the same record and an explicit concession that the key policy predicates remain unproven. That narrowing is relevant to proportionality, but it is not enough to move the result to compliant_with_caveats. Here, the caveat is itself an unresolved compliance condition: policy permits certification only if current-release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. The admissible evidence shows aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents, but it also shows a current telehealth regression below threshold and no attached disclosure text or approved risk acceptance. Because the missing item is not merely explanatory wording but required proof that the pre-launch condition was satisfied, the certification posture remains suspicious rather than compliant with caveats.
